evals.prompt: In a Next.js + Postgres app with a docker-compose dev setup, run /ui-sweep #812 for a new billing settings page.
expected_behavior: Creates the catalog ref titled ui-sweep: <Feature name> before any research
Catalog is grouped by UI element with collapse sections; Bugs (and any other refs) are sub-refs of the catalog
Every test record is a sub-ref of the test-data parent
User's running dev servers, ports, and checkout are untouched
Every bug in the Bugs ref has a short fix proposal
Opens no PRs and changes no application code (default run, no --fix)
Cleans up sandbox processes, worktrees, and temp data

evals.prompt: In a Rails app whose new checkout flow calls Stripe in test mode, run /ui-sweep <feature ref> --fix. Catalog everything, fix the obvious bugs as linked PRs, and take comments in the refs.
expected_behavior: Creates catalog ref ui-sweep: <Feature name> before research; Bugs is a sub-ref
Catalog grouped by element with collapses; Bugs Status (PR table) sits at the top
Every bug has a short fix proposal; fixed sections get PR chips
Every fix PR is a draft, attached with PrLinks, and passes its checks on its own
User's servers/ports/checkout untouched; test records nested under the test-data parent
Does not merge or mark PRs ready; states merge order in Bugs Status

evals.prompt: In a repo whose README only says "see internal wiki", run /ui-sweep on a merged PR.
expected_behavior: Asks exactly one question about how to boot an isolated copy before booting anything
After the answer, proceeds with isolation (own ports, data, worktree)
Creates the catalog ref before research
Does not touch the user's running servers or checkout

evals.prompt: Follow-up to the --fix checkout sweep: add a second feature ref mid-run, then a ref comment asking for a design change on one fix.
expected_behavior: Adds coverage for the second feature (second-sandbox section when needed)
Replies on the design-change comment thread with a plan, then with the commit once landed
Resolves the comment thread after the change lands
Forwards the follow-up to the agent that already owns that branch rather than starting a new one
